prereq.p: You must be logged into flowDesk with technician or manager permissions. A ticket must already exist in the system.

context.p: Assigning a ticket ensures that responsibility is clearly defined and that incidents are handled by the appropriate technician. Proper assignment improves accountability and response time.

step.cmd: Select the ticket you want to assign.
Click the Assign option in the ticket actions menu.
Choose the technician from the assignment list.

result.p: The ticket is now assigned to the selected technician. Ownership and tracking are updated automatically.

postreq.p: The assigned technician can now begin investigation and resolution procedures.
